newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein weaker, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein weaker, trade quiet.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were weaker in late trading on Tuesday on the back of poor demand and declines in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,455-60 rupiah at the opening. Crude palm oil was on offer at 1,250-55 rupiah/kg in Medan.
"There was not much going on in the market today," one trader said. "The on-going election campaign coupled with falls in Malaysia kept buyers at the sidelines."
Traders said prices were likely to be soft through the week, with demand staying weak until the May 29 general election.
